name: session-info
description: Session pane: context, cost and turns, the last turn's tokens, cache and tools, a task list Claude keeps, live plan usage bars, running agents, the last build and test run, the Git state of the repository and its submodules, and a treeview of the files this session created, modified or deleted.

openOnStart.title: Open the pane when the session starts
openOnStart.description: Open the pane without /session-info. On a terminal narrower than 144 columns (110 after you opened the pane once), the pane waits until you widen the terminal or run /session-info.

showSession.title: Show the Session section
showSession.description: Context window as a stacked bar by category, cost, duration and turn stats.

showLastTurn.title: Show the Last turn section
showLastTurn.description: Result, duration and cost of the last turn, its model, effort and requests, token and cache counts, and the tools it called.

showTodos.title: Show the Todos section
showTodos.description: Give Claude a todo_write tool and show the task list it keeps for work with several steps. Off removes the tool and its prompt section.

showAgents.title: Show the Agents section
showAgents.description: Subagents and teammates of the session with their status.

showChecks.title: Show the Checks section
showChecks.description: Status of the last build and the last test run the session started, with error lines or failed test names.

showGit.title: Show the Git section
showGit.description: Branch and upstream state, working-tree counts, the last commit, an operation in progress and the submodules that changed.

gitClient.title: Git client
gitClient.description: Command that the branch name (or g) opens in a new terminal window, in the repository root, for example lazygit, gitui or tig. Use double quotes around a path with spaces. Leave empty to turn it off.

showChanges.title: Show the Changes section
showChanges.description: Treeview of the files the session created, modified or deleted.

alerts.title: Usage and context alerts
alerts.description: Notify once when a usage window reaches 80% and 90%, and when the context window reaches 85%.

viewer.title: Diff viewer
viewer.description: auto: git diff.guitool, then VS Code, then inline. git: git difftool --gui. vscode: code --diff. inline: inside the pane.

editor.title: Editor for new files
editor.description: auto: VS Code when on the PATH, else the app the system associates with the file. vscode: code <file>. system: the associated app.

paneBackground.title: Pane background in the terminal
paneBackground.description: A color for the body of the pane in the terminal, as hex (#2e3440) or a color name, for example your terminal's background. Leave empty to keep the color Claude Code draws. The desktop app ignores it.

icons.title: Icon set
icons.description: unicode works everywhere; nerd needs a Nerd Font; emoji needs a terminal that draws emoji two cells wide.

buildPattern.title: Extra build commands
buildPattern.description: A regular expression (case-insensitive) for more commands to treat as a build, matched against each command segment, for example ^make( |$). Leave empty for the built-in list.

testPattern.title: Extra test commands
testPattern.description: A regular expression (case-insensitive) for more commands to treat as a test run, for example ^make test|^just test. Leave empty for the built-in list.
